extensionDescription.message: Automatically converts BYN prices into USD, EUR, RUB and 30+ more currencies on Belarusian websites. No manual conversion needed.
extensionDescription.description: Shown in the Chrome Web Store listing and on chrome://extensions. Max 132 characters.

popupCurrencies.description: Name of the popup tab holding the list of chosen currencies.

popupConverter.description: Name of the popup tab that converts an amount between two currencies.

popupConvertAmount.description: Label above the converter's amount field.

popupConvertFrom.description: Accessible label of the converter's first currency list.

popupConvertTo.description: Accessible label of the converter's second currency list.

popupConvertSwap.description: Accessible label of the button between the converter's two fields.

popupConvertEnter.description: Shown in the preview on the converter tab while the amount field holds no number.

popupSites.description: Name of the popup tab with a switch per supported site.

popupSitesHint.description: Small hint above the list of sites.

site_onliner_by.description: onliner.by itself and its subdomains without a line of their own.

popupSubdomains.description: Accessible label of the chevron that folds a site's subdomains on the Sites tab.

popupRegionEmpty.description: Shown on the Sites tab under a region that has no sites yet.

popupSourceHint.message: Not shown on Belarusian sites, whose prices are already in BYN
popupSourceHint.description: Tooltip on the source currency row in the popup.

popupPreviewNone.message: Add a currency to see prices converted
popupPreviewNone.description: Shown in the preview when no currency is chosen.

popupPreviewNoRates.description: Shown in the preview when no exchange rates could be read.

popupPreviewDate.description: Under the preview: the day the rates were published.

popupPreviewStale.description: Under the preview when the latest rates could not be fetched.

popupReorderHint.description: Small hint above the list of chosen currencies.

popupAdd.description: The big button under the currency list.

popupSearch.description: Placeholder of the search box in the add-currency picker.

popupBack.description: Accessible label of the picker's back button.

popupNoMatch.description: Shown in the picker when the search matches no currency.

popupRemove.description: Accessible label of the cross on a currency row.

popupAddCode.description: Accessible label of a currency in the add-currency picker that is not chosen yet.

popupEmpty.message: No currencies yet. Add one to see prices converted.
popupEmpty.description: Shown in place of the list when no currency is chosen.

popupPer.description: Under a row's rate: what amount of the currency the rate is for.
